meta.name: nine-virtues-leadership-assessment
meta.description: Use when evaluating leadership character or matching candidates to positions of authority. Applies Gao Yao's nine complementary virtues (九德) framework to assess balance, consistency, and suitability for household, state, or imperial governance roles.

copy.tagline: 评估领导品格，匹配治理岗位
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在招聘或晋升中评估候选人的领导品格
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate leadership character and match candidates to governance roles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess leadership character in hiring or promotion decisions

howto.what: Claude 会使用皋陶九德框架评估领导者的性格平衡、一致性，并根据其展现的德行数量推荐适合的治理层级（家庭、邦国、最高职位），还会提出发展建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求评估领导性格或匹配候选人到权威职位时触发，例如描述某人行为或询问其适合何种官职。

say.text: 请用九德框架评估一下这个候选人的领导力。
根据九德，刘邦适合统治天下吗？
帮我用九德诊断团队领导者的短板。
say.note: Claude 会指出缺失的德行，并给出培养建议。

howto.what_en: Claude applies Gao Yao's nine virtues framework to evaluate balance, consistency, and suitability for leadership roles at household, state, or imperial levels, and suggests development paths based on demonstrated virtues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests leadership character evaluation or candidate matching to positions of authority, e.g., by describing someone's behavior or asking about role suitability.

say_en.text: Evaluate this candidate's leadership using the nine virtues framework.
According to the nine virtues, is Liu Bang fit to rule the empire?
say_en.note: Claude will check against the nine virtues standards for the highest office.

say_en.text: Diagnose a team leader's weaknesses using the nine virtues.
say_en.note: Claude will identify missing virtues and suggest cultivation methods.
